name: Prezto
description: Install prezto, a configuration framework for zsh, in the remote user's home directory. Installs zsh and git when the base image does not already carry them.

setZshAsDefault.description: Change the remote user's login shell to zsh?

extraZshrc.description: Extra lines to run at the end of ~/.zshrc, for shell integrations such as 'source <(fzf --zsh)'.
